original_goal:
[Module: Request Loan | TC-010 | Type: Negative | Priority: High]
Title: Down payment below 10% of loan amount is rejected

▶ Start URL:    http://localhost:8080/request-loan
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "loan_amount": 10000,
  "down_payment": 500
}

Preconditions:
  User is on the Request Loan page; Loan Type is selected

Steps to Execute:
  1. Enter '10000' in Loan Amount
  2. Enter '500' in Down Payment
  3. Click 'Request Loan'

Expected Result:
  Inline error on Down Payment: "must be ≥ 10% of Loan Amount"; form does not submit; no loan is created

Notes from prior verification:
  Down payment of 500 is intentionally less than 10% of 10000 (should be ≥1000) to validate client-side/server-side rejection. The radio control for loan type is present per DOM but selection was assumed per precondition.
expected_outcome: Inline error on Down Payment: "must be ≥ 10% of Loan Amount"; form does not submit; no loan is created
